feed.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT

entry.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT
entry.summary:
CODESEPARATOR lacks significant utility in the absence of conditional statements. Its primary intended benefit—enabling more compact scripts—is not realized unless the script employs conditionals that necessitate separating parts of the code for different execution branches. By adhering to best practices, such as using distinct scripts or inputs for each conditional branch, the need to commit to a masked script is eliminated.
In practical terms, the specific example discussed does not require Alice’s signature in segment S1, and, consequently, there is no need for CODESEPARATOR to be involved at all. This renders its inclusion unnecessary and highlights the importance of thoughtful script structuring. The discussion remains open for suggestions of more compelling use cases where CODESEPARATOR might demonstrate unique advantages.
